name: ARV02: MMD Coverage by Days on Drugs
description: Multi-month dispensing coverage based on days on drugs
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson: {"version": 1, "themeUuid": "cbde3fc4-833a-11f1-b08c-f4053e2709b9", "conditions": [], "sqlPreview": "SELECT CASE WHEN days_on_drugs >= 180 THEN '6 months' WHEN days_on_drugs >= 90 THEN '3-5 months' ELSE '1 month' END AS supply_category, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order WHERE is_active_on_art = 1 GROUP BY supply_category", "themeConfig": {"fields": [{"key": "supply_category", "type": "string", "label": "Supply Category"}], "sourceTable": "mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order", "patientIdColumn": "client_id"}}
sqlTemplate:
WITH active_art_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM (
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order
        WHERE is_active_on_art = 1
          AND coverage_start_date <= :endDate
          AND (coverage_end_date >= :endDate - INTERVAL 90 DAY OR coverage_end_date IS NULL)
        UNION
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_return_date
        WHERE return_date >= :endDate - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND return_date <= :endDate
    ) as potential_active
    WHERE client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
        WHERE transfer_out_date IS NOT NULL AND transfer_out_date <= :endDate
    )
    AND client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT person_id FROM person
        WHERE dead = 1 AND death_date <= :endDate
    )
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN days_on_drugs >= 180 THEN "6 months MMD"
        WHEN days_on_drugs >= 90 THEN "3-5 months MMD"
        WHEN days_on_drugs >= 30 THEN "1 month supply"
        ELSE "Less than 1 month"
    END AS supply_category,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
    ROUND(AVG(days_on_drugs), 1) AS avg_days,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 1) AS percentage
FROM active_art_base base
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order arv ON base.client_id = arv.client_id
WHERE arv.days_on_drugs IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY supply_category
ORDER BY MIN(days_on_drugs) DESC
